body.h: This is a variation of the weave where the feeder changes after every five passes. It starts just like the weave. Anne does a sweep feed on two count, passing to her left, the middle, her right and then the middle again. She also passes to each juggler in turn: Clare, then Ben, then Daniel. Clare, Ben and Daniel pass to Anne on six count. Clare and Ben swap places after passing with Anne. After Anne has made five passes as the feeder, Daniel becomes the new feeder. Clare is in the middle of the pattern, she has to turn left to face the new feeder. People say: 'turn left at Havana' to remember this!
In this pattern, when you are feeding you pass on two count, otherwise you pass on six count.

Note: the diagram doesn't show the whole pattern. The last diagram is just like the first, except Anne has taken on Daniel's role, Ben has taken on Clare's role, Clare has taken on Anne's role and Daniel has taken on Ben's role.
